business_problem: Riverty's CRM activities were fragmented and lacked transparency, which slowed sales processes and limited how effectively teams used the company's Dynamics 365 CRM environment to manage customer engagement.
solution_summary: Riverty worked with Capgemini Invent to embed generative AI directly into its sales operations by integrating Microsoft Copilot for Sales with the company's Dynamics 365 CRM platform and upgrading to Microsoft Dynamics Sales Premium. The nine-week project was organized around business alignment, technical readiness, and user adoption rather than a narrow software install. Capgemini mapped the AI rollout to Riverty's sales objectives, then onboarded teams through hands-on sessions covering meeting preparation, email summarization, and CRM data maintenance. Copilot for Sales uses CRM context to surface information faster inside daily workflows, while the Sales Premium upgrade expands the AI feature set and creates a broader foundation for future customer-facing and partner-management processes. The result was an operational CRM stack where AI assistance, change management, and platform modernization were delivered together to improve day-to-day selling efficiency.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Sales
solution_components.role: Provides AI assistance for meeting preparation, email summarization, and CRM data maintenance inside Riverty's sales workflows.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 CRM
solution_components.role: Acts as Riverty's sales system of record and the operational data source that Copilot augments.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Dynamics Sales Premium
solution_components.role: Extends the CRM environment with additional AI-enabled capabilities and a foundation for broader future workflows.

data_flow: Sales teams work in Dynamics 365 CRM, where customer and activity data are used by Microsoft Copilot for Sales to prepare meetings, summarize email context, and help maintain CRM records; the Sales Premium upgrade extends those AI-assisted workflows and speeds information retrieval across sales operations.
business_outcome: Riverty improved sales-team productivity and CRM adoption, making customer information faster to retrieve and the CRM easier to use while establishing a stronger foundation for AI-assisted sales and partner-management workflows.
